description: The Claude Code adapter's binding of capability classes to harness tier aliases — internal to runtime/: the class is the vocabulary users see everywhere else, the alias is how this harness spells a tier. The Agent tool's `model` field accepts ONLY the tier aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) — never a full model id, verified live 2026-09-13 — so every class rides an alias, and the launcher exports each coding class under its alias's ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL variable: one alias carries one export per launch. code-plan rides fable, the top tier. code-review rides fable too, for the dispatch's `model:` check only: its model is never the fable export (that would make the reviewer follow code-plan, as it once followed code-high on opus — 2026-09-13) but reaches its agent file, on both paths, and the dispatch guard drops the dispatch's alias under a fabric launch so the file decides.
